definitions.explanation: An item of cultural property designated by the Japanese government as having exceptional historical or artistic value, the highest classification of cultural property in Japan.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{城|しろ}→城：03255_shiro⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{国宝|こくほう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{指定|してい}→指定：00373_shitei⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: This castle has been designated as a national treasure.

examples.japanese: {国宝|こくほう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{絵画|かいが}→絵画：02597_kaiga⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{美術館|びじゅつかん}→美術館：01717_bijutsukan⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I went to the museum to see the national treasure paintings.
Japan has more than a thousand national treasures.

notes:
{国宝|こくほう} is the highest classification of cultural property in Japan, designated by the national government under the Cultural Properties Protection Act.

FORMS:
{国|こく} (country) + {宝|ほう} (treasure)

TYPES:
Includes buildings, paintings, sculptures, crafts, calligraphy, swords, and historical documents of exceptional importance.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {国宝|こくほう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{指定|してい}→指定：00373_shitei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to designate as a national treasure
- {国宝|こくほう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{指定|してい}→指定：00373_shitei⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧: to be designated as a national treasure
- {国宝|こくほう}{級|きゅう}: national-treasure class (figurative)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{重要|じゅうよう}{文化財|ぶんかざい}→重要文化財：14689_juuyoubunkazai⟧: important cultural property (one level below {国宝|こくほう})
- ⟦{世界|せかい}{遺産|いさん}→世界遺産：04897_sekaiisan⟧: world heritage site
- ⟦{文化|ぶんか}{遺産|いさん}→文化遺産：17353_bunkaisan⟧: cultural heritage
